# Phase Three — Thirty Final Refinements

1. Verify reconciliation core source laws before endpoint exposure.
2. Verify read-only inspect never writes persistence.
3. Verify current-account route rejects unauthenticated access.
4. Verify route output contains no identity-shaped values.
5. Verify healthy summary can be parsed by humans without JSON.
6. Verify stale holds are visible even with no execution record.
7. Verify unknown execution status counts inconsistent.
8. Verify unknown reservation status does not inflate known counters.
9. Verify startup profiler cost with current tree after retention work.
10. Trace `deps.js` imports to concrete call sites before lazy loading.
11. Avoid global lazy proxy magic if explicit factory boundaries exist.
12. Keep startup logging bounded and secret-free.
13. Measure total require time again after optimization.
14. Measure full isolated HTTP-ready time again after optimization.
15. Verify workflow handoff does not store opaque blobs in local storage.
16. Prefer canonical route plus query parameters for simple handoffs.
17. Add explicit versioning if a handoff payload needs structured encoding.
18. Avoid introducing JSON storage/protocol where current constraint forbids it.
19. Verify handoff target maps to an existing catalog route.
20. Verify handoff source remains useful when target launch fails.
21. Test mobile commerce footer after reconciliation/continuity changes.
22. Test keyboard favorite interaction and pressed state.
23. Test Apps and Games catalog ordering after recent memory.
24. Test no duplicate memory badges after repeated renders.
25. Audit public marketing copy for generic/empty descriptions.
26. Prioritize premium value by fulfillment readiness, not pricing imagination.
27. Keep game purchases reversible where fulfillment can fail.
28. Keep product credit economics server authoritative.
29. Run full touched-file readback and structural audit.
30. End only with evidence-backed completed vs remaining state.
